text:
anna: Quick PSA — discovered a dup side-effect in the onboarding sampleapp when using our webhook handler + SDK token refresh. Repro steps in a sec.

mike: ugh, got a repro? can you paste logs?

anna: Yep. Sequence: 1) client calls /generate -> SDK starts request stream 2) token refresh happens mid-stream (auth refresh triggers 401->refresh->retry) 3) upstream returns 429 on retry and SDK retries without a replay guard -> webhook handler receives both 'in-progress' and retried completion events.

sam: do you have a minimal log snippet?

anna: Log:```
2024-06-12T15:02:41Z INFO request:start id=xyz
2024-06-12T15:02:41Z INFO auth:refresh start
2024-06-12T15:02:41Z INFO request:retry id=xyz reason=401
2024-06-12T15:02:41Z WARN http 429 id=xyz
2024-06-12T15:02:42Z INFO request:retry id=xyz reason=429
2024-06-12T15:02:42Z INFO webhook:emit event=completion id=xyz
2024-06-12T15:02:42Z INFO webhook:emit event=completion id=xyz (duplicate)
```

ivy: hmm. This is subtly different from the classic double-submit on 429 — the trigger is the mid-stream token rotation + resume path. Our current client retry logic treats the retry as a fresh request and doesn't attach the same idempotency marker.

mike: Does the sampleapp use idempotency-key headers today? I thought we left that to the app layer.

anna: Sampleapp didn't. We intended to demonstrate simple integration but it exposed realistic onboarding friction. New users see duplicate side-effects and blame the webhook consumer.

ci-bot: ci:build #342 failed on e2e (flaky webhook tests). See https://ci.example.com/342

sam: Proposed fix options: 1) SDK-level: attach an ephemeral replay id across retries (e.g., `x-sdk-replay-id`) and have retry path preserve it; 2) App-level: update sampleapp to set idempotency header for each outgoing action; 3) Console docs: add onboarding note about token refresh edgecases.

darren: I lean SDK-level default for devex sampleapps. If we expose a small header that's opt-out, it reduces surprise. But need to be careful for streaming: keep header immutable across retry/resume.

mike: Agree. Implementation notes: - generate replay id at request start - attach as `x-replay-id` on all HTTP moves (including internal resume attempts) - ensure streaming finish event includes the id so webhook consumers can dedupe.

ivy: Also add jittered backoff on 429 but with an important caveat: for streaming requests we should prefer a resume-with-kv approach vs full retry. If we must retry, send the same replay id and a `x-resume-offset` when available.

anna: For the sampleapp PR I'm thinking: update Node/Go examples to set `X-Idempotency-Key` on side-effecting requests and add a short snippet showing `sdk.replayId` usage. Here's the Node example to include in docs:```js
const replayId = req.sdkContext.replayId || generateId();
await fetch(process.env.CONSUMER_URL, {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'X-Idempotency-Key': replayId, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ event, replayId })
});
```

sam: tiny UX Q: should the SDK expose `replayId` by default on the request context or behind an opt-in config flag? default on is better for sampleapps but might surprise some advanced users.

mike: default-on but documented and configurable. Add telemetry flag for `replay_id_used` so we can see adoption and any unintended side-effects.

darren: Test plan: create a flaky-network e2e that forces token refresh mid-stream + 429 on retry and assert that webhook consumer receives exactly one completion event. Add unit tests for header preservation across retry logic.

anna: I'll open a draft PR to the sampleapp and the SDKs (node + python) with these changes. Title: "preserve-replay-id-across-retries + sampleapp idempotency headers". Will link tests.

ivy: Nice. Also add a short blurb in the quickstart troubleshooting: "If you see duplicate webhook side effects during onboarding, enable `X-Idempotency-Key` on your consumer or upgrade SDK to preserve replay ids."

mike: thanks anna. If you want I can help with the e2e harness (flaky network simulation).

anna: Please do. Will ping with PR link in this thread. :thumbsup:
